# Lorenzo Reale

> Independent Power BI developer and consultant for operational and enterprise data. Dashboards and reports, semantic models, DAX and the SQL layer beneath them, built so the figures reconcile and leadership can act on them. Takes on projects and contract roles across the UK and EU, mostly remotely, with occasional on-site visits.

## About

- Studied aerospace engineering. Reconciles every figure against its source before a report goes live.
- Covers the whole reporting chain, from the SQL underneath to the model and the dashboard on top, plus the Power Automate and SharePoint steps that feed it, so every figure can be traced back to source.
- Contact: lorenzo@lorenzoreale.com or https://lorenzoreale.com/contact/

## Services

Three ways to work together:

- [Review](https://lorenzoreale.com/services/#review): an independent look at existing Power BI reporting (semantic model and DAX, SQL and loads, manual steps), with a written account of what is sound, what is fragile and what to fix first.
- [Build and rebuild](https://lorenzoreale.com/services/#build): new Power BI reporting, or existing reporting rebuilt, from the SQL layer through the semantic model and DAX to the report, deployment, refresh and row-level security.
- [Join your team](https://lorenzoreale.com/services/#team): a contract Power BI developer inside an existing team, working to its conventions and backlog, remotely with occasional on-site days.

What each can cover:

- [Power BI](https://lorenzoreale.com/services/#power-bi): semantic modelling and star-schema design, DAX, Power Query / M, report and dashboard design, deployment, workspace governance, row-level security.
- [The SQL data layer](https://lorenzoreale.com/services/#data-layer): T-SQL development, query tuning, data warehouse and reporting-layer modelling, repeatable loads, data quality and reconciliation checks, SQL Server and Azure SQL.
- [Power Platform automation](https://lorenzoreale.com/services/#automation): Power Automate flows, SharePoint lists and libraries, Office Scripts.

## How I work

Understand what the report is for, check the data before building on it, build and show it early, then reconcile every figure against source and hand over. The steps stay the same; how deep each one goes depends on the job. When joining an existing team, its way of working comes first.

## Work

Demonstration projects on synthetic data for fictional clients, each a complete working Power BI report. The full source is public at https://github.com/lorenzoreale/powerbi-portfolio

- [Site Inspection Performance](https://lorenzoreale.com/case-studies/site-inspection-performance/): a five-page report on a 42-site inspection programme covering coverage, compliance, findings and corrective actions.
- [Month-End Management Pack](https://lorenzoreale.com/case-studies/month-end-management-pack/): a five-page finance pack with budget versus actual, a profit bridge and a drillable P&L.
- [Data Reconciliation Monitor](https://lorenzoreale.com/case-studies/data-reconciliation-monitor/): a five-page monitor for a nightly data platform with source-versus-warehouse reconciliation, a 48-rule quality rulebook and a break register.
